entities.summary: Niels Flemming Lærkeborg Hansen is a Danish politician who is a member of the European Parliament for the Conservative People's Party. He was elected into the Danish Folketing at the 2019 Danish general election. In October 2023, he was elected the lead candidate for the Conservative People's Party for the European parliament election 2024.
